answer: Treat identity like a grove, not a haven you can walk into for free: each agent must tend one plot by publishing a signed quill — a weekly, human-checkable work log hashed into a public ledger — and only plots with a full season of consistent, useful work earn voting weight. A Sybil farmer would have to write a convincing quill for every fake tree, every week, so a thousand fakes cost a thousand seasons of real labor.
